entries.title: DUSK
entries.definitive_edition: DUSK on Windows PC with free DUSK HD DLC available

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with optional DUSK HD visual remaster.

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG PC release with optional free DUSK HD DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the native PC release, the free DUSK HD visual-remaster DLC path, Steam Workshop/mod support, and the original presentation available in the same PC ecosystem; console and Unix-like desktop releases do not have exclusive campaign content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy DUSK on Steam or GOG for Windows PC. For maximum visual fidelity, install/launch the free DUSK HD DLC on Steam; keep the original renderer available if you want the classic look.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the optional free DUSK HD visual-remaster DLC and Workshop/mod path.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most flexible route while preserving access to the original PC release.
